title: Operation Plane Policy Gate v1
description: Defines the Policy Fabric boundary for Workspace Operation Plane commands, artifact admission, trust boundaries, and human/agent remediation. Policy logic must not be embedded inside prophet-platform, UI repos, TurtleTerm, BearBrowser, or agents.

ArtifactAdmissionGateType.description: The set of artifact admission gate types that Policy Fabric enforces. Each gate type maps to a distinct block reason and responsible actor.

OperationCommand.description: Operation Plane commands authorized to call Policy Fabric gate evaluation.

RemediationActor.description: The actor responsible for resolving a policy gate block. Determines who can fix the block.

TrustBoundaryType.description: Categories of trust boundaries recognized by the Operation Plane policy gate.

GateStatus.description: The current state of a policy gate record.

action.description: Machine-readable action key the responsible actor must perform.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the actor must do to resolve the gate.

link_ref.description: Optional URI or reference to a resource that assists with remediation.

PolicyGateRecord.description: A machine-checkable and serializable record of a policy gate evaluation result for an Operation Plane command. Aligned with prophet-core-contracts#1.

gate_id.description: Unique identifier for this gate record instance.

artifact_ref.description: Reference to the artifact being gated, if applicable.

operation_id.description: Reference to the Operation Plane operation that triggered this gate.

expires_at.description: When this gate record expires. Null if no expiry.

audit_required.description: Whether an audit trail must be generated for this gate event.

remediation_options.description: Actor-relative list of remediation actions available to unblock this gate.

trust_boundary_ref.description: Reference to a TrustBoundaryRecord if a trust boundary was involved.

policy_refs.description: Policy references that triggered this gate.

override_ref.description: Reference to an active OverridePolicyRecord that has cleared this gate.

metadata.description: Additional gate metadata for downstream consumers.

PolicyEvaluationRequest.description: Request shape for Policy Fabric gate evaluation of an Operation Plane command. The Operation Plane runtime calls Policy Fabric with this shape before executing any authorized command.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation request.

operation_id.description: The Operation Plane operation being authorized, if already created.

artifact_ref.description: Reference to the artifact subject of admission, if applicable.

artifact_metadata.description: Metadata about the artifact being admitted, used for admission gate evaluation.

trust_boundary_refs.description: Trust boundary identifiers relevant to this evaluation.

context.description: Arbitrary context passed by the caller for policy evaluation.

PolicyEvaluationResponse.description: Response shape from Policy Fabric for an Operation Plane gate evaluation. Actor-relative and remediation-ready. UI may render response fields; UI must not be the policy authority.

response_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation response.

request_id.description: Correlates this response to the originating PolicyEvaluationRequest.

outcome.description: Authorization decision. Only allow or deny; deferral is modeled as a pending gate record.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the outcome. UI may render this field.

responsible_actor.description: The actor responsible for resolving the block, if outcome is deny.

audit_required.description: Whether an audit trail is required for this authorization decision.

remediation_options.description: Actor-relative remediation options. Empty when outcome is allow.

gate_record_ids.description: IDs of PolicyGateRecord documents generated for this evaluation.

policy_refs.description: Policy references that produced this response.

expires_at.description: If outcome is allow with time-bounded scope, the expiry of the authorization.

TrustBoundaryRecord.description: A record describing a trust boundary that Policy Fabric must evaluate when processing Operation Plane commands.

boundary_id.description: Unique identifier for this trust boundary.

policy_refs.description: Policy references governing this trust boundary.

connector_ref.description: Reference to the external connector configuration, if boundary_type is external_connector.

endpoint_ref.description: Reference to the model endpoint or service, if applicable.

reviewed_at.description: When the trust boundary was last reviewed by its owner_actor.

OverridePolicyRecord.description: An override policy record that allows a responsible actor to temporarily or permanently waive a policy gate within a defined scope. Every override must produce an audit record.

override_id.description: Unique identifier for this override record.

scope.description: The scope within which this override applies.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for the override, retained for audit.

expires_at.description: When this override expires. All overrides must have an expiry.

affected_artifact_refs.description: Artifact references affected by this override.

affected_gate_types.description: The gate types this override waives.

affected_commands.description: The Operation Plane commands this override applies to.

audit_record_ref.description: Reference to the audit record generated for this override. Required; no override may be issued without an audit record.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the override.

revocation_reason.description: Reason the override was revoked before expiry, if applicable.
